Airing out a boathouse involves carefully removing all items from the interior to ensure the space is fresh and clean. This process helps eliminate any lingering odors, pests, or clutter that may have accumulated over time. It also allows the boathouse to breathe, which can improve air quality and create a more pleasant environment for those who use it. After airing out, the boathouse is typically cleaned and prepared for its next use, whether for storage, guest accommodations, or as a gathering space. 

P.P.S. Do not forget the notice board.
